title: A new chat project in the directory
summary:
Two community projects joined the directory: a chat interface and a prompt generator with image previews.

EvilChat joined the Chat directory with links to its app and source code. It’s a responsive, dark-themed interface built with the Pollinations API.

Promptgenerator.art joined the creative projects directory. It turns simple ideas into structured prompts for Midjourney, DALL·E, and ChatGPT, with a Pollinations-powered visualization preview.
